name: Fire and Tsunami at the Harbor

npcs.name: Rico Dela Cruz
dialogue: Floodwater and typhoon damage already block the harbor road. Now fire and a tsunami warning add danger.
Use the inland evacuation path. Do not go to the beach, cross floodwater, or enter smoke.
after_dialogue: The harbor group is moving inland. Keep everyone together and follow official alerts.

choice.prompt: Fire blocks the dock road while the tsunami alarm sounds. What route?

options.text: Guide people inland to marked high ground
options.result: Residents move away from fire and the coast.
options.consequence: You chose a route away from both hazards.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.text: Use the dock road before it closes
options.result: The dock route moves people toward both hazards.
options.consequence: You sent residents toward the fire and shoreline.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

npcs.name: Dr. Mira Santos
dialogue: I hurt my ankle when the harbor road cracked. The smoke is getting closer.
Please bring the emergency radio so I can call for help, then carry me inland.
after_dialogue: I can hear the response team. Please carry me away from the shore and smoke.
rescue_dialogue: I cannot walk safely with my injured leg. Bring the first-aid kit, then carry me to inland high ground.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. Please carry me to inland high ground.
npcs.rescue_hint: Collect the first-aid kit, then speak with Dr. Mira Santos again.

quests.title: Find first aid for injured residents
Secure the fire blanket if the route is safe
Get the harbor evacuation plan from Tarsi
Help Dr. Mira Santos reach higher ground

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.rescue_pilar: Find Dr. Mira Santos and give her the radio so she can call the response team.
quests.community: Find Rico Dela Cruz and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach the marked inland safe zone.
quests.cover: When shaking starts, get under the sturdy table in the green cover field.

lessons: Use the planned safe exit and go to the family or community meeting place.
Stay with your group and tell responders if someone is missing.
Do not return to a fire-affected building until authorities say it is safe.

quiz.question: Smoke blocks your usual exit during a fire. What should you do?
options: Use a planned alternate safe exit and meet at the designated point
Hide in a room and wait without telling anyone
Go back inside after reaching safety to collect supplies
quiz.explanation: Know alternate escape routes and a meeting place. Do not re-enter until authorities say it is safe.

briefing: A fuel-area fire blocks one route just as a tsunami warning sounds. Lead residents away from both hazards toward safe high ground, help vulnerable people first, and skip nonessential supplies. Reach the departure point after the headcount.
story_clue: Coordinates point to a facility in the North East Plains.
